== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Worldslayer is a highly advanced [[Aethertech weapon]], comparable in power to a world-level enchanted device. It is primarily used by [[Sola Kalter|Sola]], also known as the [[Fallen Sword]], and manifests as a handheld gun that emits a crimson, razor-like light capable of cutting through space and existence itself. The weapon functions by projecting sharp beams or bridges of energy that can pierce through shields, fortresses, and even the bodies of powerful entities. Its destructive potential is immense; it has been used to puncture starships, bisect kings, and strike through massive creatures like the [[D’Niss|D'Niss]]. However, using the weapon carries significant risks, as it requires time to recharge and its deployment can cause global environmental disasters or threaten the safety of the user and their surroundings. Beyond [[Sola Kalter|Sola]]'s personal armament, versions of the Worldslayer have also been utilized by ships such as [[The Last Horizon]].}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Worldslayer is an [[Aethertech weapon]] held within [[Sola Kalter|Sola]]'s inventory. This gun shines in the [[Aether]] like a deadly star and possesses the power to project a bridge that can annihilate space. After considering summoning the weapon, [[Sola Kalter|Sola]] retrieves it and reaches for its power. Ultimately, she puts the item away.}}
